subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should forced gateway restarts adopt a bounded 5s best-effort drain before exit, or must `--force` remain an immediate escape hatch?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it changes an operator-visible restart contract that current help and docs still describe as immediate.

options.title: Require proof and wording alignment
options.body: Ask for live pending-reply restart proof and update help/docs to describe the bounded best-effort force drain before merge.

options.title: Accept the bounded force contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the 5s forced-drain behavior as the new operator contract even before broader restart replay work lands.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if `--force` must remain a no-wait recovery path and choose a different pending-reply recovery design.

recommendation.title: Require proof and wording alignment
recommendation.body: Ask for live pending-reply restart proof and update help/docs to describe the bounded best-effort force drain before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to adjacent restart-shutdown recovery history and is the best available owner for the operator-contract decision.
